features.name: Electron window launches
features.evidence: scripts/smoke.cjs launched a visible Electron BrowserWindow and loaded the renderer/preload; nodeIntegration disabled and contextIsolation enabled. npm run check and npm run build passed.

features.name: Document list on the left
features.evidence: Electron smoke clicked the import button with a stubbed native file chooser, imported design-notes.md, verified its title in rendered DOM and left-panel geometry. Native chooser interaction itself is not automated.

features.name: QA panel on the right
features.evidence: Electron smoke verified right-panel geometry, entered architecture in the form and submitted, then verified persisted answer with document citations. Local keyword retrieval only; no AI model connected.

features.name: Local persistent data directory
features.evidence: Electron smoke confirmed documents-meta.json and qa-history.json under userData/knowledge-base-data. A second Electron process using data/smoke-1791860341363 restored one indexed document and one question record.
